description: List submissions for one of your forms. Returns counts + per-submission metadata by default; set includeContent to include message bodies (third-party PII). Errors with: unauthorized, not_found, forbidden. Requires a full-access token.

folder.description: Which folder to list. Defaults to inbox.

formId.description: A form id from create_form or list_forms, e.g. frm_...

includeContent.description: Include full submission message bodies (third-party PII). Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of submissions to return.

name: list_submissions
